description: Create a resource pack project: init writes the project document, the pack root metadata for the pinned release version, a 64x64 placeholder icon, and the assets directory skeleton in one preflighted batch. An occupied target refuses the whole batch and reports every conflicting path; nothing is overwritten. The project document is written once and then read only.

allowMinecraftNamespace.description: init only: allow the reserved minecraft namespace; refused without it.

category.description: catalog only: exact texture category filter.

description.description: init only: pack description of 1 to 128 characters; defaults to the name.

dryRun.description: build only: plan only, write nothing.

force.description: extract only: allow overwriting existing files.

includeFamilies.description: catalog only: include the mask family index.

jarPath.description: extract only: caller-specified client jar path.

minecraftVersion.description: init only: release version 1.19.3 through 26.3 (for example "1.21.9" or "26.3").

mkdir.description: extract only: create missing parent directories.

mode.description: Pack subcommand: init, build, catalog, extract, check, or package.

name.description: init only: project name; defaults to the directory name.

namespace.description: init only: resource namespace of the pack; lowercase letters, digits, underscore, dot, and dash.

outputDir.description: extract only: directory receiving assets/ entries.

pageSize.description: catalog only: entries per page, at most 1000.

projectDir.description: init only: project directory to create the skeleton in.

recipe.description: build only: a single recipe file; omitted reads every *.recipe.json.

resourcePackVersion.description: init only: resource-pack format N or N.M overriding the release version.

style.description: init only: builtin style id or a .style.json path recorded in the project document; defaults to vanilla.

vanillaPath.description: catalog only: vanilla tree directory containing assets/.

name: pack_asset
